mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are those used with pronominal verbs (S‟habiller, Se reveiller, se laver, se lever)."
Reflexive Pronouns are those used with pronominal verbs (S‟habiller, Se reveiller, se laver, se lever).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is called the first person, the one spoken to is the second person; and the one spoken of is the third person."
The speaker is called the first person, the one spoken to is the second person; and the one spoken of is the third person.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a group of words often without a finite verb of its own, and thus being unable to make a complete sense."
A phrase is a group of words often without a finite verb of its own, and thus being unable to make a complete sense.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a grammatical word that can be used to replace a noun in a given sentence."
A pronoun is a grammatical word that can be used to replace a noun in a given sentence.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a word, group of words or phrase used as exclamation to show emotion or the state of mind of the speaker."
An interjection is a word, group of words or phrase used as exclamation to show emotion or the state of mind of the speaker.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to introduce an object or a thing to the listener while the definite article elaborates on the known or partier presented object / thing."
An indefinite article is used to introduce an object or a thing to the listener while the definite article elaborates on the known or partier presented object / thing.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used to denote things either animate or inanimate, and the gender is purely coincidental."
Nouns are used to denote things either animate or inanimate, and the gender is purely coincidental.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used in sentences, do this exercise."
Having seen how conjunctions are used in sentences, do this exercise.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the secondary clause in a sentence."
The subordinate clause is the secondary clause in a sentence.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used to describe physical or mental state that existed in the past such as this sentence."
The imperfect tense is used to describe physical or mental state that existed in the past such as this sentence.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used before an adjective or an adverb."
Aussi is used before an adjective or an adverb.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a clause that could stand on its own and would not need any other grammatical words or clause to complete its though so as to have a complete meaning, e.g."
An independent clause is a clause that could stand on its own and would not need any other grammatical words or clause to complete its though so as to have a complete meaning, e.g.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are used with a verb before a comparative, before a noun with "de " and before the adverb plus, moins and trop."
Adverbs of quantity are used with a verb before a comparative, before a noun with "de " and before the adverb plus, moins and trop.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used before feminine objects, things etc."
De la is used before feminine objects, things etc.
fib: ______ is a complex process that provides a bridge between speech and writing.
Reading
Reading is a complex process that provides a bridge between speech and writing.
______ is used after a preposition as in these sentences.
Usually an emphatic pronoun
Usually an emphatic pronoun is used after a preposition as in these sentences.
______ is used when a noun is qualified.
an indefinite article
an indefinite article is used when a noun is qualified.
______ is a type of sentence that is used to express ideas.
declarative sentence
The declarative sentence is a type of sentence that is used to express ideas.
______ is a group of grammatical elements comprising of adjectives or even nouns functioning as modifier in a sentence.
adjectival phrase
An adjectival phrase is a group of grammatical elements comprising of adjectives or even nouns functioning as modifier in a sentence.
______ is a dependent clause used as an adjective in a sentence.
adjectival clause
An adjectival clause is a dependent clause used as an adjective in a sentence.
______ is a dependent clause used as a noun in a sentence.
nominal clause
A nominal clause is a dependent clause used as a noun in a sentence.
______ are the verb and phrases in the sentences.
grammatical elements underlined
The grammatical elements underlined are the verb and phrases in the sentences.
______ is considered to be irregular when its stem (and even the endings in some other cases like infinitive faire, dire) changes from one person to another.
verb
A verb is considered to be irregular when its stem (and even the endings in some other cases like infinitive faire, dire) changes from one person to another.
______ is the life- wire of sentences in a given language.
Remember a verb
Remember a verb is the life- wire of sentences in a given language.
______ are used to emphasize the subject or the object in declarative or interrogative sentences.
emphatic pronouns
The emphatic pronouns are used to emphasize the subject or the object in declarative or interrogative sentences.
______ is made up of the main verb and its auxiliaries.
verb phrase
A verb phrase is made up of the main verb and its auxiliaries.
______ is used after a preposition when the subject of the verb is " on" ; " Chacun" or "personne ".
Soi as a pronoun
Soi as a pronoun is used after a preposition when the subject of the verb is " on" ; " Chacun" or "personne ".
